description: This file contains utility functions for handling command-line arguments related to Vitest test reporting, loading Vitest reports from specified arguments, and formatting time durations.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for Vitest report configurations, with defaults and flags.

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads a Vitest report based on provided parsed arguments and a prefix, returning the report data as JSON.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a time value in milliseconds into a string with specified decimal digits.
